title: Roman Telescope Maps Dark Matter

scenes.text: NASA's Roman telescope will chart dark matter across the Milky Way
scenes.query: Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope launch

scenes.text: Its wide‑field infrared camera can image 100 times more sky than Hubble each night
scenes.label: 100X SKY COVERAGE

scenes.text: Gravitational lensing data will reveal the invisible distribution of dark matter clusters
scenes.label: GRAVITATIONAL LENSING

scenes.text: The mission aims to test theories about dark energy accelerating the universe’s expansion
scenes.label: TESTING DARK ENERGY

scenes.text: Follow for daily science that blows your mind.

description: Launching soon, the Roman Space Telescope will use powerful imaging to map the hidden scaffolding of dark matter and probe dark energy. Stay tuned for the cosmos revealed. Follow for daily science!
